audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer sides disagreed with the content win[] and the packet levelChart, including 2+ items, which the full layer gave to Kassadin while the content layer gave it to Lissandra.
audit.why: Kassadin has no pre-6 trade pattern: Null Sphere is 650 to your 725 Q and his only escape, Riftwalk, does not exist until 6. Late, Riftwalk is 500 range and point-and-click Frozen Tomb catches him mid-blink, which is why the content layer keeps the last rows for you.
audit.corrected: Full sides realigned to Lissandra, Skill, Skill, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra, with each why rewritten to argue its row.

audit.why: Pre-6 dominance, level 6 Frozen Tomb, the first-item race against his scaling, and late Riftwalk spam are all covered by the four content spikes.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; phases[5] and phases[6] whys now key to Riftwalk's 5s-to-2s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive numbers were absent: Riftwalk's 500 range against your 450 W root, its escalating mana cost, and Force Pulse charging off spells cast near him.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s at 500 range and repeated blinks cost more mana; Force Pulse is 21-17s and charges from nearby spellcasts, so mindless Q spam next to him arms his slow. Your W is 450 and your E is 24s at rank 1 — one exit, not two.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with the real numbers; dosFull[0].d now tells you to stand so his blink lands inside your root; dontsFull[2].d explains why chasing a blink you cannot match spends your only exit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and breakdown.cooldowns held no number.
audit.corrected: All three fixed below with kit-grounded replacements.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Kassadin has no trade at level 1 — Q-shatter him from 725 while Null Sphere only reaches 650 and its shield is thin.

edits.before: W online: anyone who closes onto you eats a root. The anti-engage layer is already real at level 2.
edits.after: W is online, but Null Sphere's shield and his innate magic-damage cut blunt your follow-up here.

edits.before: E claw completes the kit — you now have the lane's strangest engage and a guaranteed exit. Greed carefully; the claw is slow.
edits.after: E claw completes the kit, but Force Pulse charges off spells cast near him — poke at 725 and never linger inside its 400 cone.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q spam stops hurting your mana. Chip Kassadin every time he touches the wave.
edits.after: Lost Chapter frees your mana and he is at his weakest pre-6 — all-in whenever Null Sphere is down.

edits.before: Malignance spike: your R comes back absurdly fast and every tomb chains into the slow field. Force picks with E-W-R.
edits.after: Malignance shortens your R while he is still buying his first item — keep tombing him off the map before Riftwalk reaches 2s.

edits.before: Late Liss opens every fight: claw in, tomb the carry, root the peel, and walk out through the panic.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 2s at rank 3, but point-and-click Frozen Tomb catches him mid-blink and W roots the follow-up.

edits.before: Kassadin wins by landing Riftwalk, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Kassadin wins by surviving to a 2-second Riftwalk, blinking past your 450 root, and reaching carries you can only tomb once.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps in for the Nether Blade auto, W-root the wind-up into full rotation and walk — the reset is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. It governs your forward steps. - R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1 falling to 2s, 500 range — stacked blinks cost extra mana, so the third one hurts him. - Null Sphere: 9s to 7s from 650, and it shields him. - Force Pulse: 21s to 17s, charged by spells cast near him. - Your R is 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry through picks — a tombed Kassadin cannot Riftwalk out, so claw-root-tomb turns his one blink onto your backline into a corpse.

edits.before: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Riftwalk lands at 500 and your W roots at 450 — stand so his blink ends inside your root radius.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: Frozen Tomb on yourself is untargetable and invulnerable — pop it as Null Sphere and the Nether Blade auto land, then W-root him before Riftwalk comes back.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: Riftwalk is 500 range on 5-to-2s and each blink adds damage; your claw is one exit on 24s at rank 1 — chasing spends yours to feed his.

edits.before: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk: 500 range, 5s at rank 1 down to 2s, and each rapid blink costs more mana. It is the whole green-light system.

notes: CHART: six full-layer rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet, including 2+ items (full said Kassadin, content said Lissandra). The content win[] values already hold the correct verdicts, so no paired win[N] edit exists — a before==after edit would be rejected. RATINGS untouched, including phases[6].rating 7/10 which sat under the old Kassadin verdict; I could not tell from the data whether the rating scale is owner-favourable or difficulty-favourable, so I left it rather than guess. NOT ASSERTED: missingInteractions claims Null Sphere is a channel your W/R cancels, sourced from the kit's 'channel' flag — but Riot's own text says Null Sphere *interrupts* channels, it does not say Kassadin channels it. Per the brief's rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about cancelling it. Both COPY_PASTE_BLEED findings and COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT fixed.
